content.intro: M4: Financing Just Energy Transition | Chapter 3

content.text: The chapter underscores the indispensable role of the private sector in accelerating the energy transition. It explores strategies to attract private investment, such as blended finance models, public-private partnerships (PPPs), and risk mitigation mechanisms. The chapter discusses common barriers to private sector engagement, including political instability, regulatory uncertainty, and high upfront costs. It also highlights tools like guarantees, insurance products, and concessional finance to reduce investment risks and improve the bankability of renewable energy projects.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Private Sector Investment in Sustainable Energy
lessons.description: This lesson explores the critical role of private sector investment in driving the transition to sustainable energy, emphasizing the need for significant capital mobilization beyond public finance to meet global clean energy targets.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Risk Mitigation Strategies
lessons.description: This lesson introduces the concept of de-risking renewable energy investments, particularly in developing countries, through policy and financial de- risking

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Blended Finance
lessons.description: This chapter explores blended finance as a strategy for mobilizing private sector investment in renewable energy projects, especially in developing countries. It highlights how blended finance combines concessional funding with private capital to de-risk high-impact clean energy projects.
